scope: Stage 1 goal replay and local claim/progress safety with atomic storage; no replication, durability, liveness or refinement proof.
evidence_method: Compose completed frozen runs; every selected execution definition (excluding suite scheduling labels), executed module/config hash and mapped Rust hash matches the final checkout. Original per-run manifest hashes remain recorded; later additions of permanence invariants were checked separately. The two large goal cases were moved out of fast after measurement; this changes suite scheduling only.
